answers.core: They should be core properties to complement `Node2D.global_position` and `Node2D.global_rotation` but for 3D
answers.workaround:
getting global position: `global_transform.origin`
setting global position: `global_transform.origin = new_pos`
getting global rotation: `global_transform.basis.get_euler()`
setting global rotation:
`rotation = (get_parent().global_transform.basis.inverse() * Basis(new_rot)).get_euler()`
(probably simpler way to do it)
